summary: Zero of the twenty time-not-supplied rows can be confirmed from a company source as landing in either the 2026-09-17 amc or the 2026-09-18 bmo slot. Two are positively refuted by a company release that already happened (CMMB 19 Aug 2026, ALAR 2 Sep 2026). Two are refuted by the issuer's own filing index putting the real event weeks away (NB ~mid-Oct on an Item 2.02 cadence of 14 Oct 2025; TRT ~22-23 Sep on a 23 Sep historical cadence). One has no earnings event at all and is instead a restatement/delisting situation (HUBG, Nasdaq exception expired 14 Sep, lender deadline 30 Nov). Three are structurally out on session even if the date were right, because the issuer releases pre-US-open (DAVA, YRD, IH). Two look like prior-year relabels of a September 2025 release (IH from 18 Sep 2025, HTLM from 17 Sep 2025 — both dates taken off the URL path). The remainder are sub-$40m names with no discoverable IR schedule, where the row is a filing-deadline projection. Nothing here justifies a deep hunter tonight. The two worth a cheap EDGAR watch rather than a hunt are VFS (Q2 2026 results genuinely outstanding and undated since the VFTP divestment, but historically released bmo) and HTLM (2026 half-year print genuinely missing, prior-year analogue landed 17 Sep, but no company source and no call to settle a session).
